findings.current:
And the people capable of posing such a threat were hundreds of yards away, fighting countless monsters.

More precisely, their subordinates were fighting under their command.
findings.defect: The second sentence makes the distant fighters’ subordinates the combatants. The source identifies the monsters they are fighting as the concealed figures’ controlled subordinates.
findings.rationale: 그들의 조종에 따라 움직이는 수하들 describes the minions under the concealed figures’ control, not subordinates fighting on the distant people’s side.
findings.replacement:
The people capable of seeing through their concealment were hundreds of yards away, fighting countless monsters.

Those monsters were the concealed figures’ subordinates, moving under their control.
findings.source:
그리고 그런 위협을 줄 수 있는 이들은, 수백여 장이나 떨어진 곳에서 무수한 괴물들과 맞서 싸우는 와중이었다.

정확히는, 그들의 조종에 따라 움직이는 수하들이었지만.

findings.current: “Come on, what else is there to life? I’ve spent all this time following your ass around, Captain. Now I wouldn’t even flinch if the fucking Heavenly Demon himself showed up.”
findings.defect: The punchline changes the Heavenly Demon’s grandfather into the Heavenly Demon himself.
findings.rationale: 천마 할애비 explicitly means the Heavenly Demon’s grandfather; the exaggerated kinship is part of Mujin’s joke.
findings.replacement: “Fuck it, what’s life anyway? I’ve spent all this time following your ass around, Captain. Now I wouldn’t even flinch if the Heavenly Demon’s granddad showed up.”
findings.source: “씨바 거, 인생 뭐 있습니까? 조장님 뒤꽁무니만 쫓다 보니까 이제는 천마 할애비가 나타나도 안 쫄립니다.”

findings.current: With a deafening roar that sounded as if the sky had split apart, countless shadows poured down, blanketing every direction.
findings.defect: “Poured down” suggests an attack from above, though the force has encircled them and the source does not give the shadows a downward trajectory.
findings.rationale: 하늘이 갈라지는 듯한 modifies the roar; 온 사방 describes where the shadows arrive from.
findings.replacement: With a deafening roar that sounded as if the sky had split apart, countless shadows came pouring in from every direction.
findings.source: 하늘이 갈라지는 듯한 굉음과 함께, 무수한 그림자들이 온 사방을 뒤덮으며 쏟아졌다.

findings.current: There was no shame in being a coward if it meant surviving.
findings.defect: The draft calls a person who retreats a coward, then excuses it. The source rejects that label in a matter of survival.
findings.rationale: 비겁함이란 없다 denies cowardice rather than treating it as shame-free.
findings.replacement: There was no such thing as cowardice when it came to survival.

findings.current: If someone wanted to live and return home, even if they had to do whatever it took, I’d gladly protect them.
findings.defect: “Do whatever it took” loses the specific choice just offered: leaving the battle line.
findings.rationale: 그렇게라도 points back to 물러나라, Jin’s invitation to withdraw from the formation.
findings.replacement: If anyone wanted to fall back so they could make it home alive, I’d gladly protect them.
findings.source: 그렇게라도 살아서 돌아가고자 하는 이가 있다면, 나는 그를 기꺼이 보호할 것이다.

findings.current: Remembering why they had to be here. Remembering the familiar faces those monsters had killed.
findings.defect: “Familiar” identifies the dead but drops the grief in 그리운.
findings.rationale: 그리운 conveys longing for the dead, not merely recognition.
findings.replacement: Remembering why they had to be here. Remembering the faces of those they missed, killed by the monsters.
findings.source: 자신들이 이곳에 있어야 하는 이유를 떠올리며, 놈들에 의해 죽어 간 그리운 얼굴들을 떠올리며.

summary: The draft reverses who controls the monsters in the closing scene and changes several smaller details of the battle and dialogue.
